text:
[Council File 26-1145; CD 10]
City Administrative Officer report relative to a proposed Agreement between the Department of Animal Services and Stray Cat Alliance for the provision of facility operation services at the Jefferson Park Animal Services Center located at 3612 11th Avenue.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Financial Policies Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 17, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 16, 2026)
summary: The city will contract with Stray Cat Alliance to operate and maintain the animal shelter at Jefferson Park.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Sep 16, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 2, 2026); Council action final
